name: Achensee Strandbad
kurzbeschreibung: The Strandbad Maurach at Achensee offers fine sandy beaches, crystal-clear water, and breathtaking views of the Karwendel mountain range.
beschreibung: At the southern end of the Achensee near Maurach, stretches of shoreline invite visitors to swim. At around 930 metres above sea level, about nine kilometres long and up to 133 metres deep, the Achensee is the largest lake in Tyrol and lies between the Karwendel Nature Park and the Rofan mountains. Its calcareous water shimmers from turquoise blue to aquamarine. The described Strandbad area near Maurach is advertised with fine sandy beaches, crystal-clear water and views of the Karwendel mountain range. In Maurach there are several public bathing areas along the lakeshore; an establishment with the unambiguous name “Strandbad Maurach” could not be confirmed through official sources. Details of address, telephone, email, website and opening hours could therefore not be verified and remain open.
